text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even the atmosphere here feels different! As expected of the vaunted G1 moniker.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hang on, I know what'll help. My mother taught me a breathing exercise back when I was still an actor.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's great for getting rid of nerves, so let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: First, set your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands on your stomach. Then focus on breathing with your stomach.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Breathe in through your nose… and breathe out. Good, just like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Breathe in… Breathe out… Hehe. I guess I was a little nervous too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can hear the din of the crowd over the quiet sound of our synced breathing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right, how was that? Do you feel better now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Great! On that note, I'll be off now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I hope you're excited for the show I'm about to put on.
